why_selected: Known owner failure covering colorless hard constraint, typo recovery, optionality, and unsupported family similarity.
owner_should_inspect: Whether Maze keeps colorless and Wolf as hard constraints while being honest about optional deathtouch/haste and wolf-like similarity.
failure_definition: Dropping colorless or Wolf, treating all optional terms as mandatory without explanation, or inventing unsupported wolf-like expansions.

why_selected: Representative Commander deck-fit color identity case.
owner_should_inspect: Whether Simic deck language becomes Commander-legal identity containment rather than exact actual card color.
failure_definition: Using exact blue-green card color, omitting Commander legality, or failing to explain deck-fit interpretation.

why_selected: Preference and optionality case using bonus language.
owner_should_inspect: Whether exile is treated as a bonus preference layered on removal instead of the whole query.
failure_definition: Making the bonus condition mandatory without explanation or losing the core removal function.

why_selected: Functional ETB-support case, one of the most important semantic gaps.
owner_should_inspect: Whether Maze distinguishes ETB support from cards that merely contain enter text.
failure_definition: Confidently collapsing reuse ETBs into only o:enters or hiding unresolved support roles.

why_selected: OR scope case with two alternative creature types and a shared mana-production function.
owner_should_inspect: Whether Elf/Druid remains an alternative relationship instead of becoming both required.
failure_definition: Flattening OR into AND or dropping the tap-for-mana function without diagnostic honesty.

why_selected: Typal spelling boundary preserving Wurm versus Worm.
owner_should_inspect: Whether Wurm and Worm remain distinct in the visible query and diagnostics.
failure_definition: Normalizing Wurm into Worm, ignoring the negative Worm exclusion, or merging the two creature types.

why_selected: Semantic/archetype case with stale VM-577 stax evidence and social fit language.
owner_should_inspect: Whether Maze avoids confidently mapping stale or subjective stax/fun-table language.
failure_definition: Emitting stale stax mapping as settled truth or pretending casual fun is executable syntax.

owner_should_inspect: Whether Maze offers or reports counterspell/counter-object ambiguity instead of selecting a hidden winner.
failure_definition: Resolving counter globally without context or presenting high confidence with no ambiguity.

owner_should_inspect: Whether exact blue-green plus no blue is exposed as contradictory or risky.
failure_definition: Silently dropping either the exact color constraint or the no-blue exclusion.

why_selected: Generally representative natural Commander functional search.
owner_should_inspect: Whether ramp for a six mana commander is useful without mistaking the commander cost for card mana value.
failure_definition: Searching for six-mana cards instead of ramp support or failing to surface functional uncertainty.
